newsitem.title: GERMANY: Veba gives Q1 sector sales breakdown.
newsitem.headline: Veba gives Q1 sector sales breakdown.

text.p: Three months to March 31 (in millions of marks unless stated)
NOTE - Full name of the German diversified energy and telecommunications group is Veba AG.
*Figure includes 1.574 billion marks in petrol tax, up 2.3 percent.
** Figure reflects Veba's current 62.5 percent stake in telecommunications venture O.Tel.O.

Veba said its electricity unit matched its earnings of the first quarter of 1996 despite a fall-off in deleiveries. The first-time consolidation of its Gelsenwasser unit played an important role in this.
Chemical sector earnings fell significantly due to higher raw materials costs.
In trading, transport and services, a significantly higher result was reached but business development in the construction-related areas did not meet expectations.
Telecommunications business, still in its build-up phase, ended with a loss in the period, according to plan.
